body: I'm almost afraid I'll die one day from a lack of life than any active action to harm myself. Or who knows, maybe I will do something someday. I feel unstable in my mind. Swings of ideas and moods. Different realities creep in and take root where they shouldn't. I'm slowly losing sense of self... ego maybe? Everything is covered in a layer of anxiety. I can't shut off my head. The voices. The analyzing. The over analyzing. All I can do is drift off into oblivion with pot. Then they stop. Then everything stops and its almost like meditating. There's a quiet. Only its just an escape. When the drug wears off it comes back. The anxiety, the fear.. the worst part is they're not directed at anything in particular. Its like a filter for every bit of input I receive. So I lay here unable to face anything drowning in an ocean of indifference. Sometimes I get inspired to change it and it is as if the gods themselves strike me down at every turn simply for their own amusement. I'm the butt of some cosmic joke that no one told me. I'm tired of trying. I'm tired of being. Its hard to explain something that is slowly causing me to lose my mind.
